comentarios: Calls (alarm calls?) from female responding to playback of male song (XC64219). After about two minutes of playback, this female responded strongly by approaching to within 5-10 meters and calling almost continuously for 2-3 minutes. The bird kept quite low in the dense understory (generally within 50 cm of the ground) and moved rather erratically, often flicking/wagging its tail. Further playback after about five minutes elicited a diminished response (the bird resumed calling but did not approach, while a second bird of unknown sex was also heard calling in the distance), and after a few more minutes the bird(s) eventually lost interest. No males were heard singing or seen.
